with a cough.definitionKo: 웃음이나 기침 등이 갑자기 터져 나오는 소리. 또는 그 모양.
with a cough.englishDescription: A word imitating laughter or a cough, etc., suddenly and repeatedly bursting out or starting, or describing such a state.

with a cough.definitionKo: 웃음이나 기침 등이 갑자기 반복해서 터져 나오는 소리. 또는 그 모양.
with a cough.englishDescription: A word imitating laughter or a cough, etc., suddenly and repeatedly bursting out or starting, or describing such a state.

with a cough.definitionKo: 가슴 속에서 울려 나오는 기침 소리.
with a cough.englishDescription: A word imitating a coughing sound from deep in one's chest.

with a harsh cry.englishDescription: A word imitating the sound of a child crying gratingly.

with a laughter.definitionKo: 입을 크게 벌리고 크게 웃는 소리. 또는 그 모양.
with a laughter.englishDescription: A word imitating the sound made when one laughs out loud with one's mouth wide open, or a word describing the scene.

with a laughter.definitionKo: 입을 약간 크게 벌리고 크게 웃는 소리. 또는 그 모양.
with a laughter.englishDescription: A word imitating the sound made when one laughs out loud with one's mouth open a little, or a word describing the scene.

with a rustle.definitionKo: 마른 나뭇잎이나 나뭇가지 등을 가볍게 밟는 소리. 또는 그 모양.
with a rustle.englishDescription: A word imitating the sound or describing the action of lightly stepping on withered leaves, branches, etc.

with a rustle.definitionKo: 물기 없는 물건이 서로 닿거나 바스러지는 소리. 또는 그 모양.
with a rustle.englishDescription: A word imitating the sound or describing the motion of dry things, such as leaves or twigs, touching each other or crumbling.

with a rustle.definitionKo: 마른 나뭇잎이나 나뭇가지 등을 가볍게 밟는 소리. 또는 그 모양.
with a rustle.englishDescription: A word imitating the sound made when a dry leaf or tree bough, etc., is stepped on lightly or describing that scene.

with a rustle.definitionKo: 마른 나뭇잎이나 나뭇가지 등을 자꾸 가볍게 밟는 소리. 또는 그 모양.
with a rustle.englishDescription: A word imitating the sound made when a dry leaf or tree bough, etc., is stepped on lightly or describing that scene.

with a rustle.definitionKo: 낙엽이나 종이 등과 같이 마르고 얇은 물체를 밟거나 만질 때 나는 소리.
with a rustle.englishDescription: A word imitating the sound made when a dry and thin object such as a fallen leaf, paper, etc., is stepped on or touched.

with a rustle.definitionKo: 낙엽이나 종이 등과 같이 마르고 얇은 물체를 자꾸 밟거나 만질 때 나는 소리.
with a rustle.englishDescription: A word imitating the sound made when a dry and thin object such as a fallen leaf, paper, etc., is stepped on or touched repeatedly.

with a rustle.definitionKo: 가랑잎이나 마른 풀, 얇고 빳빳한 물건이 서로 스치거나 바스러질 때 나는 소리.
with a rustle.englishDescription: A word imitating the sound made when fallen leaves, dry grass, or thin, stiff things brush against each other or crumble.

with a rustle.definitionKo: 마른 나뭇잎이나 나뭇가지 등을 자꾸 가볍게 밟는 소리. 또는 그 모양.
with a rustle.englishDescription: A word imitating the sound made when a dry leaf or tree bough, etc., is stepped on lightly or describing that scene.

with a rustle.definitionKo: 마른 나뭇잎이나 종이 등을 자꾸 밟거나 들출 때 나는 소리.
with a rustle.englishDescription: A word imitating the sound made when a dry leaf or paper, etc., is repeatedly stepped on or lifted.

with a rustle.definitionKo: 마른 나뭇잎이나 종이 등을 밟거나 들출 때 나는 소리.
with a rustle.englishDescription: A word imitating the sound made when a dry leaf or paper, etc., is stepped on or lifted.

with a soft smile.definitionKo: 입을 조금 벌리고 부드럽게 웃는 소리. 또는 그 모양.
with a soft smile.englishDescription: A word imitating the sound or describing the motion of laughing softly with one's mouth slightly open.

with a steady stare.definitionKo: 눈을 동그랗게 뜨고 말끄러미 쳐다보는 모양.
with a steady stare.englishDescription: In the manner of looking at someone or something intently with wide eyes.
with a steady stare.englishExpression: with a steady stare; with wide fixed eyes

woolen robe.englishDescription: Clothes made of fur or a pelt.

work in double harness.definitionKo: 부부가 모두 직업을 가지고 돈을 벌다.
work in double harness.englishDescription: For both the husband and wife to have jobs and work for a living.
work in double harness.englishExpression: (couple) work together; work for a double income; work in double harness

world war.englishDescription: A huge war affecting the entire world.

wrath.englishExpression: rage; fury; violent anger; wrath; exasperation

wrath.englishDescription: A feeling of rage and mortification.

wrath.definitionKo: 남이 맞서지 못할 만큼 강하고 날카로운 기세.
wrath.englishDescription: A strong and sharp energy from a person that intimidates others.

wrath.definitionKo: 몹시 화를 내며 노여워함. 또는 그런 감정.
wrath.englishDescription: The state of being enraged and frustrated, or such a feeling.

written statement.definitionKo: 공적인 위치에 있는 사람이 어떤 일에 대한 의견이나 태도를 알리기 위해 공식적으로 발표하는 글.
written statement.englishDescription: A piece of writing announced officially by a person in a public position in order to inform people of his/her opinion or attitude about a matter.

written statement.definitionKo: 사건의 피의자나 참고인이 자신의 한 일과 겪은 것에 대해 알리는 글.
written statement.englishDescription: A statement written by a suspect or a witness of an incident in order to tell what he/she did and experienced.

yaksik.definitionKo: 찹쌀에 꿀, 설탕, 대추, 간장, 참기름, 밤, 잣 등을 섞어서 찐 음식.
yaksik.englishDescription: A dish made by steaming glutinous rice mixed with honey, sugar, jujubes, soy sauce, sesame oil, chestnuts, pine nuts, etc.
yaksik.englishExpression: yaksik; sweet rice with nuts and jujubes

yay.englishDescription: An exclamation uttered when the speaker is surprised or glad.

yay.definitionKo: 매우 반갑거나 좋을 때 내는 소리.
yay.englishDescription: An exclamation uttered when the speaker feels very glad or good.

yay.definitionKo: 반갑거나 기분이 좋아서 어쩔 줄을 모를 때 내는 소리.
yay.englishDescription: An exclamation uttered when the speaker does not know what to do because he/she is glad or happy.

yay.definitionKo: 반갑거나 기분이 좋아서 어쩔 줄을 모를 때 내는 소리.
yay.englishDescription: An exclamation uttered when the speaker does not know what to do because he/she is glad or happy.

yay.definitionKo: 뜻밖에 기쁜 일이 생겼을 때 내는 소리.
yay.englishDescription: An exclamation uttered when something pleasant happens unexpectedly.

yeongnam.englishDescription: Gyeongsangbuk-do, or North Gyeongsang Province, and Gyeongsangnam-do, or South Gyeongsang Province.

yeot.definitionKo: 밥을 엿기름으로 발효시켜 물처럼 될 때까지 약한 불로 끓인 뒤 졸여서 만든 달고 끈적끈적한 음식.
yeot.englishDescription: A sticky sweet that is made by fermenting steamed rice with malt, heating the fermented rice at a low temperature until it becomes liquid and then reducing it to make it sticky.

your honor.definitionKo: 특정한 높은 지위의 관료를 높여 부르는 말.
your honor.englishDescription: A word used to refer to or address high-ranking officials.
your honor.englishExpression: Your Excellency; Your Grace; Your Honor

your honor.definitionKo: (옛날에) 신분이나 지위가 높은 사람을 높여 이르거나 부르는 말.
your honor.englishDescription: (archaic) A word used to refer to or address someone in a high social position or high rank in a respectful manner.
